defects.description: Unbounded index access: 'block.PostSuggestions[index]' uses the route 'index' with no bounds check, throwing IndexOutOfRangeException (HTTP 500) for any out-of-range value. Validate index against the collection size and return 404.

Missing input validation: 'language == "pt-BR" ? pkg.PtBR : pkg.EnUS' silently falls back to EnUS for any value other than 'pt-BR' (including invalid ones), masking bad input instead of returning 400/404.
